title: Labels have Human Values: Value Calibration of Subjective Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Clustering annotations into distinct human value groups based on semantic similarity of free-text rater rationales and expert-defined moral taxonomies (e.g., Schwartz theory of basic human values), then measuring group-specific model calibration, classification discrimination (AUC), and minority predictability (Earth Mover's Distance) across these value clusters.

Grouping datasets by cross-sectional annotator demographic and cultural attributes (including race, gender, age group, and geo-cultural locality) to act as proxies for underlying subjective perspectives, and evaluating multicalibration and predictive equity across these diverse identity groups.
